title: BioNTech halts mid-stage trial of personalized mRNA vaccine in colorectal cancer
snippet: Shares of Germany-based BioNTech were down as much as 8% Friday after announcing a Phase 2 trial of autogene cevumeran would be discontinued for futility. The news follows Merck and Moderna’s Phase 3 win last week for their cancer vaccine plus Keytruda in melanoma.

title: ‘Worse than expected’ Wainua data muddies water for TTR silencers
snippet: AstraZeneca and Ionis Pharmaceuticals’ data drop divulging more details from its highly watched Phase 3 transthyretin silencer trial “further confuses the picture” for Wainua when combined with the standard of care for ATTR-CM, analysts say.

title: BioXcel files for bankruptcy, will sell assets to Teva for up to $125M
snippet: Teva Pharmaceuticals is the 'stalking horse bidder' to kick off the auction process for BioXcel Therapeutics' AI-derived assets as the biotech files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy.

title: Lilly joins Novo in cardiovascular space after FDA nod for GLP-1/GIP agonist Mounjaro
snippet: With the approval, Eli Lilly’s Mounjaro becomes the first dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist indicated to lower the risk of heart attack, stroke or cardiovascular death in adults with type 2 diabetes.

title: Genentech strikes second Asia deal in a week, betting up to $1B in oncology ADC alliance with DualityBio
snippet: Through its DualityBio deal, Roche's Genentech hopes to create antibody-drug conjugates with payloads that can circumvent growing cancer drug resistance.

title: Priovant nabs first FDA approval for targeted tablet in dermatomyositis
snippet: Lisraya carries a boxed warning typical of JAK inhibitors, but otherwise has a broad label that allows use in all adults with the rare autoimmune disease, setting up the drug for blockbuster status in a few years, according to Leerink.

title: AstraZeneca, Amgen poised to challenge Dupixent’s reign with esophagitis win
snippet: Even without specific Phase 3 data yet revealed, analysts see AstraZeneca and Amgen’s Tezspire as a potential threat for Dupixent in eosinophilic esophagitis.

title: Multispecifics are transforming the CDMO development architecture
snippet: Manufacturers are being pushed beyond mAb‑era platforms into a new design model built around molecular engineering, complex analytics and amplified upstream and downstream processing.

title: CAR T for autoimmune disease benefits from oncology’s lessons—and will deliver its own
snippet: Thanks in part to the revolution cell therapy brought to treating blood cancers, the modality is now showing promise in some autoimmune applications. This expansion is poised to yield even wider benefits.
